== Summary ==
Slip, 12 August 2008 re-issue: •Forced Servitude (V), as printed on the Players Committee's re-issued Virtual Set 12 sheet (“Official text as of January 9, 2007 (Errata to card #38 on March 21, 2008)”) for [[Virtual Set 12: Martyrs & Magistrates]]. Identical to the January 2007 slip.

Source: [https://web.archive.org/web/20090220144753/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Resources/virtual/VirtualCards12.pdf VirtualCards12.pdf] (swccgpc.com, PDF dated 12 August 2008; Internet Archive capture 20 February 2009), page 4, slip 32. The PDF page was rendered at 200 dpi and the slip cut out; nothing else was changed.

Used on: [[Forced Servitude (V) (Virtual Set 12: Martyrs & Magistrates) (Original)|Forced Servitude (V) (Virtual Set 12: Martyrs & Magistrates)]].
